provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Disney Villains: The Card Game rulebook (via RulesPal)

steps.text: Each player picks a Villain (Maleficent, Jafar, Captain Hook, Scar, Ursula, Cruella de Vil) and takes that deck
Remove the special cards from the decks
Shuffle your deck facedown (Hero side up) as your draw pile
Flip 1 card Villain side up as the start of your discard pile
steps.note: A special card here gets shuffled back and redrawn

steps.text: A card matching a neighbor's top card must go to their pile
Never look through your discard pile to count
Best Villainous laugh goes first; play is clockwise
